task_name: Add sparse AI fallback and recommendation/forecast measurement

concerns_addressed: 30-day sparse fallback metadata applied symmetrically in RecommendationService and ForecastService; legacy envelopes unchanged.
Purchased attribution enforces product_id+outlet_id match against non-excluded OrderItem/Order in 30-day window with no campaign presence.
UUID idempotency via DB-backed event_uuid uniqueness: replay returns same record/idempotent_replay=true; conflicting reuse returns 409.
WAPE decimal-safe with strict <30% boundary; all-zero or insufficient histories remain pending with null WAPE; no false perfect scores.
Measurement routes admin-only (401/403) and measurement consumer reads via ActiveDataSnapshotReader; no extra external calls.

strengths: Deterministic stage/producers and clean separation between sparse history logic and measurement logic.
Safe rate handling with zero-denominator clamping and no mutation of published snapshots.
Legacy AI shapes preserved with additive-only metadata changes.

issues.description: Rolling-window start boundary inconsistent between services (datetime vs calendar precision).
